verdict.rationale: Stripe documents that one Financial Connections integration covers ACH account verification, balances, ownership details and transactions (docs-1, docs-2/3/4). Its use cases pair bank-account collection with data access in the same flow, such as ACH plus balances or payouts plus ownership (docs-8, docs-9). A beta integrator also describes using one link for both verification and fraud signals (comm-6). missing for 10: explicit documentation that a single authentication session can request multiple data permissions at once, confirmation that no re-consent or extra flow is needed to add products later, and current independent hands-on corroboration (comm-8's 2022 note that Transactions was 'Coming Soon' is dated)
